member.name: M:PaintStore_POS.ImageCache.ToFullPath(System.String)
member.summary:
Turn a stored image_path back into a path that can actually be opened.
Rows written before this existed hold an absolute path baked to one machine and one checkout folder. Anywhere else that resolves to nothing and the picture silently disappeared. Such rows are recovered by looking the file name up inside this installation's ProductImages folder.
